questions.question: For an array of shape \((2, 3)\), what shape results from `sum(axis=0)`?
questions.explanation: Axis \(0\) is reduced. The three columns remain, so the result has shape \((3,)\).
optionFeedback: This would describe reducing the columns within each row. Axis zero runs down the observations; write the two row vectors and add them element by element.
Axis \(0\) is reduced. The three columns remain, so the result has shape \((3,)\).
A reduction removes the selected axis unless keepdims is requested. Count the three column sums left after combining the two rows.
